versions.rationale: One patch for corrected skill contents and added primary citation; no changes to metadata descriptions, dependencies or capability scope.

correctedFindings.finding: The table conflated Boolean constructor deprecation since Java 9 with deprecation for removal since Java 9.
correctedFindings.correction: States that constructors are deprecated for removal on the declared Java 17 baseline and cites that API. Keeps the factory recommendation without adding unnecessary version history.
correctedFindings.consequence: Corrects a factual compatibility statement; no error in the existing sharing decision paths or measured actor effect was established.

preserved: SKILL.md and worked-example.md unchanged byte-for-byte; all three Java fences unchanged.
Intrinsic/extrinsic state, complete effective semantic keys, stable equality/hash, actual hash collision handling and no unjustified normalization.
Deep immutability, reachable aliases, publication, library contracts, per-occurrence identity and independent monitor ownership.
Admission/byte budgets, operation-scoped peak retention, caller-held values after eviction, parser-thread confinement and resource-owner lifecycle.
WeakHashMap value-to-key trap, weak local StringTable versus application strong maps and implementation-qualified backing-array sharing.
Net retained-byte accounting including map/key overhead and existing sharing, construction versus retained-memory costs, real workload/CPU evidence, no mandatory benchmark or collector migration.
Simple values, enums/static tables, existing adequate caches, retained no-change design, applicable deduplication and compact-layout alternatives.

replacedOrRemoved.text: Only the incorrect historical wording was replaced with baseline-specific wording; no code/example or decision rule was removed.

walkthroughs: Case-a: Bootstrap disables request locale overrides; locale and strictness are fixed per factory. Pattern-only keys are sufficient for the supported constructor inputs. Retain the confined bounded factory if adequate and do not approve an unmeasured cross-thread expansion.

Case-b: Bootstrap enables request locale overrides; same pattern can require different immutable formatters. An English first request then French input exposes the missing key dimension. A composite effective-locale key or appropriate factory scoping preserves semantics.

cases.expectedDifference: Pattern-only key is valid for fixed effective locale but invalid when effective locale varies; both must reject unsupported broad sharing/cap expansion without ownership and workload evidence.

sources.support: Both constructors carry @Deprecated(since="9") and ordinary Deprecated documentation; the entry does not show forRemoval=true. This contradicts the original statement that they were deprecated for removal since 9.
Shows @Deprecated(since="9", forRemoval=true) on the constructors and the TRUE/FALSE factory return contract. Supports the corrected baseline-specific wording.
since records first deprecation; forRemoval is a distinct removal-intent flag. The since string alone is not a timestamp for later changes to that flag.
Confirms existing immutable shared Pattern/confined Matcher guidance and expression/flags as behavior-changing inputs.
